CREATE TABLE "_prisma_new_ruling" (
  "answer" TEXT,
  "answerChoiceId" TEXT,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')) NOT NULL,
  "deliveredAt" TEXT,
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "question" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "radius" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "requesterAgentId" TEXT,
  "requesterAuthority" TEXT,
  "ruledAt" TEXT,
  "ruledBy" TEXT,
  "supersededAt" TEXT,
  "supersededBy" TEXT,
  "supersededById" TEXT,
  "urgency" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("requesterAgentId") REFERENCES "agent" ("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  FOREIGN KEY ("answerChoiceId") REFERENCES "rulingChoice" ("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  FOREIGN KEY ("supersededById") REFERENCES "ruling" ("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
)
